source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Three FASTag-recharge reward rules were tagged category_id 'fuel', so the engine paid their accelerated rate at every fuel merchant in merchants.json (indian_oil, bpcl, hpcl, shell, jio_bp, nayara_energy). The founder caught it on IDFC FIRST HPCL Power+, where the app said Rs.1,000 spent at BPCL earns Rs.50 - the 5% FASTag rate, on a competitor's fuel, on a card whose own terms exclude non-HPCL fuel from rewards entirely. Also on IDFC FIRST HPCL Power (2.5%) and IRCTC RBL (1.5%). A FASTag recharge is not a fuel-station spend, and all three are gated to the issuer's own app or channel, so all three are now portal_bonus on channel portal with a portal_name, which the engine never fires. No rule_name changed, so no user's cap progress is reset.
